description: This PHP class defines a data model for termination reason configuration in the OrangeHRM system's API. It implements serialization traits and constructs the model based on a TerminationReason entity, configuring which properties to expose.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class representing a termination reason configuration, prepared for API serialization with specific properties 'id' and 'name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a TerminationReason entity and sets the filters for serialization.
